labels.name: type:epic
labels.description: Apply to an outcome slice that only tracks child stories. Never on an item that opens a PR.

labels.name: type:story
labels.description: Apply to one user-visible outcome under an epic. Closes when its child reviews pass. No PR.

labels.name: type:task
labels.description: Apply to one agent-sized unit ending in one PR or one review verdict. Parent is a story.

labels.name: persona:plan
labels.description: Apply to epics, stories, and escalations (split or rewrite backlog items). Never writes code.

labels.name: persona:architect
labels.description: Apply when output is a contract: types, stubs, file boundaries, test list. No feature behavior.

labels.name: persona:build
labels.description: Apply when output is one PR implementing one task inside its owns list. Fix tasks too.

labels.name: persona:review
labels.description: Apply when output is a pass/changes verdict on one PR. Reviewers never push commits.

labels.name: wave:0
labels.description: Apply to serial foundation: shell, Astryx init, theme, frame, task contract. Gates wave 1.

labels.name: wave:1
labels.description: Apply to feature lanes that run in parallel once every wave:0 review passes.

labels.name: wave:2
labels.description: Apply to whole-app a11y, responsive, and e2e checks after every wave:1 review passes.

labels.name: area:shell
labels.description: Apply when it touches tooling, Astryx setup, theme, global CSS, or the app frame.

labels.name: area:tasks
labels.description: Apply when it touches the Task contract, composer, list and rows, or edit/delete dialogs.

labels.name: area:filters
labels.description: Apply when it touches status/priority filtering, title search, or clear completed.

labels.name: area:persistence
labels.description: Apply when it touches localStorage, the task store, or loading/empty/save-error states.

labels.name: area:a11y
labels.description: Apply when the main check is keyboard access, focus, accessible names, or responsive layout.

labels.name: area:quality
labels.description: Apply to end-to-end tests or test infrastructure that spans areas.

labels.name: priority:p0
labels.description: Apply when the foundation or core loop (add, see, complete, persist) needs it. Schedule first.

labels.name: priority:p1
labels.description: Apply when required for release but not for the core loop. Schedule after p0.

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Apply when it needs a path outside owns, a contract change, or failed 3 reviews. Comment why.
